name: hiveswarm
description: Human-governed multi-agent application security evaluation platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @hiveswarm/api" "npm run dev -w @hiveswarm/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hiveswarm/api && npm run build -w @hiveswarm/worker && npm run build -w @hiveswarm/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @hiveswarm/api && npm run typecheck -w @hiveswarm/worker && npm run typecheck -w @hiveswarm/web
